narr: Heavy rainfall and flash flooding on July 20 and 21 in El Paso and Pueblo Counties.
ev: Video shared on social from a social media partner of flash flooding/rushing water across roadway on Wooten Rd near E Platte Ave in Colorado Springs.
Ditches running full. Farm fields flooded with up to 1 ft of water depth. Lower field has ponding of water up to 2 ft of depth.
